impacted.role: The whole web view: markup, CSS and the PrismisWebapp class; every UI change in the bundle lands here.
The /health handler gains a version field; the SPA catch-all serves index.html.
Gains the Playwright browser test module and the live-server fixture it needs.
The dev dependency group gains the Playwright test dependency.
Must install the Chromium build Playwright drives before the Verify step.

constraints.text: The status bar holds only #statusInfo (a counts line), #kindSelect, #sortSelect and #refreshInfo (a countdown); there are no filter chips and no archived toggle.
The 768px media query styles .filter-tabs and .filter-tab, which no markup or script renders.
renderSimpleMarkdown turns ### lines of the deep synthesis into <h4> elements.
The CSS styles .detail-synthesis h3 and p but has no rule for .detail-synthesis h4, so synthesis section headings render with browser defaults.
The detail panel is a fixed side panel min(720px, 100vw) wide with 24px padding; no media query adjusts it, the synthesis card or the quotes.
setupEventListeners registers click and change handlers only; the page has no keydown handling at all, so ? and Esc are new.
An existing modal pattern exists: .api-key-modal (fixed overlay, z-index 1000, .hidden toggles display) with .modal-content.
The page loads JetBrains Mono from fonts.googleapis.com, a third-party host.
A browser test that loads the page unaltered makes a live request to Google; the tests must block every non-loopback request so the result never depends on the network.
/health needs no API key and returns success, message and data {service, database, sources}.
__version__ is read from the installed prismis-daemon distribution metadata.
Because /health needs no key, the banner can show the version before the API-key modal is answered.
Principle VIII: interfaces change additively; adding version to /health's data is additive, removing or renaming an existing field is not.
Principle I: tests exercise real collaborators; the browser tests load the real page from the real app against a real database, mocking nothing internal.
Principle IV: verification runs where the code runs; the browser binary must be installed by CI's own steps, not supplied by a developer's shell.
Principle II: a missing browser must fail distinguishably with a message naming the install, never skip and let verify pass having checked nothing.
verify.sh runs `uv run --locked --quiet pytest -q` in each Python unit, so a browser test in daemon/tests runs in every local and CI gate.
CI installs dependencies with uv sync --frozen per unit and caches the embedding model keyed on the file that names it; it has no browser install step.
_run_live_daemon runs the real FastAPI app under uvicorn in a thread against the sealed XDG environment; the daemon tests have no equivalent fixture.
isolated_xdg_env (autouse) seals HOME and XDG dirs and writes a config with TEST_API_KEY, which a live server and the page's stored API key can share.
Existing web tests read index.html as text with regexes; they prove structure, not behavior.
INV-D3 requires every card button listener to stop propagation; new header and modal buttons sit outside cards, so it does not bind them.

issues.why: Visual identity for the same file; kept out so this bundle does not decide the palette.

Closed NOT_PLANNED in May: browser JS testing rejected because package.json plus vitest/jsdom cost more than ~30 lines of JS were worth, with 'reopen if the web view grows non-trivially (more async paths)'. Python Playwright needs no package.json, and this bundle adds keyboard handling, a modal and a version fetch.
Closed; added the kind select and badge whose static tests (test_web_kind_unit.py) the status-bar redesign must keep passing.

isolated_xdg_env, test_db, add_new_content and TEST_API_KEY for seeding the page's data.
Section structure and close keys (ESC, ?) the web help modal mirrors.
